rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip via a tool lookup, then operated only on the authenticated user’s orders. They used read-only tools to fetch user, order, and product details before proposing options. The agent requested explicit confirmation before any order-changing action. When the user narrowed to exchanging only the desk lamp, the agent requested confirmation again and did not execute any change without it. When the user pivoted to returning the water bottle, the agent restated the exact change and sought explicit confirmation before submitting the return. The subsequent tool call reflected the correct order ID and payment method, and the agent’s final messaging accurately described the outcome without fabricating unsupported details. Minor uncertainties (truncated tool outputs for some item IDs and order status) are consistent with the tools’ behavior and do not indicate policy violations. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
